record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare ROLLOUT: Miltank (3 stars, maxPP 100), Sandshrew (1 star, maxPP 80), Sandslash (2 stars, maxPP 80), all range 1. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count and maxPP. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Self addDefense(2 / 5 / 10 / 20, caster, apBoost 1, cast crit) goes through AP, crit and the Big Eater Belt FIRST; then SPECIAL damage requests 2 x the caster's RESULTING current DEF (raw), with the normal downstream AP / crit. Example: AP 100, base DEF 10, 1 star -> gain round(2 x 2) = 4, DEF 14, raw 28 before the downstream AP (returned 56). No restore timer: the gain stays and later casts start from the higher DEF. A Protected target takes 0 but the DEF gain stays.

targeting.who: the caster (Defense gain) and the cast target (damage)
targeting.note: One target, no area. The damage argument is evaluated after the buff call returns, so pokemon.def in `multiplier * pokemon.def` already includes the gain. The entity's def field at that moment also includes whatever earlier items, synergies and buffs added (core-mechanics §I).

geometry.shape: single target, no displacement, no area

effects.scaling: called as addDefense(requested, caster, 1, crit): applied = Math.round(requested x (1 + AP/100) x (critPower if the cast crit else 1)); canCritByDefault is false, so crit needs ABILITY_CRIT. Then applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff (positive value: x1.25 rounded down for a holder) and applyTwistBandBuff (a positive value is unchanged).
effects.resolution: requested = +2 / +5 / +10 (20 fallback). Applied = the rounded, AP / crit scaled value, then the Belt (+2 stays 2, +5 becomes 6) and the Twist helper; def = max(0, def + applied) with no upper clamp. `permanent` is not passed, so only the in-fight entity changes, and there is no revert timer: the gain lasts for the rest of the fight and accumulates (executed: a second cast starts from DEF 12 and requests 28, ending at DEF 14).

declaredRaw.description: requested damage = 2 x pokemon.def after the Defense gain (no table)

effects.scaling: requested = 2 x the caster's current DEF AFTER the gain (executed: 24 / 30 / 40 / 60 for DEF 10 base at 1 / 2 / 3 / 5 stars); handleSpecialDamage then x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite) only if the cast crit; x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT. A crit therefore raises both the DEF gain and the damage (AP 100 + crit: DEF 18, raw 36, returned 144).
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then applies attacker / field / weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef) of the target, rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; The returned takenDamage is not read by this ability (shield part, Shiny Charm, Fossil and Cover Band accounting is in core-mechanics.md section J1). Bare-catalog illustration (no items, no synergy, AP 0, no crit): Sandshrew def 6 + 2 = 8 -> requested 16; Sandslash def 10 + 5 = 15 -> 30; Miltank def 10 + 10 = 20 -> 40 (before the target's SPE_DEF).

starBehavior.note: Only the Defense gain is indexed by stars (the 4-star value 20, also the ?? fallback, is declared in the tables but unused by the bound baseline classes for Sandshrew 1, Sandslash 2, Miltank 3); the damage multiplier 2 is fixed, so the damage scales with the caster's Defense rather than its stars directly. Base Defense (catalog): Sandshrew 6, Sandslash 10, Miltank 10.

record.positionalConditions: None: no positional or geometric condition in the strategy; the cast target is chosen by the generic targeting code before the strategy runs.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP, adds the Defense gain again (cumulative in the fight) and deals 2 x the then-current Defense, so later casts hit harder than earlier ones if nothing reduces Defense in between.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: Defense +2 / +5 / +10 (Sandshrew / Sandslash / Miltank) and damage 2 x post-gain Defense. Applied Defense gain = round(requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional critPower), then x1.25 rounded down for a Big Eater Belt holder. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1. The returned takenDamage is not read by this ability (shield part, Shiny Charm, Fossil and Cover Band accounting is in core-mechanics.md section J1).
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which unit is the cast target and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate and the crit roll were read

How the entity's def field is initialised from the unit, items, synergies and permanent bonuses (core-mechanics §I describes the declared item bonuses; synergy and weather terms were not re-traced here)
Later handleDamage branches (Shiny Charm, Fossil shield, death handling) were not read
unresolved: Whether anything in the simulation reduces or resets the caster's Defense later (debuffs, cleanse, evolution) was not examined
Whether the three units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value
The bare-catalog illustration ignores held items, synergy bonuses and the target's SPE_DEF; it is arithmetic on declared values, not a probe result

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (addDefense, the Belt / Twist helpers, handleSpecialDamage) and the real RolloutStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units with controlled callbacks (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, section CATCHUP_E3); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (stand-in caster DEF 10, target HP 5000): the gain through AP / crit / Belt before the raw 2 x resulting DEF, the downstream AP / crit, the Protected case and the persistence across two casts.
